children: Bowhead Specialty Holdings elected Derek Walker to its board of directors, effective September 12, 2026.
Recommended by GPC Partners Investments (SPV III) LP pursuant to Board Nominee Agreement
Fills vacancy on the Board; will stand for reelection at 2029 annual meeting (class II) with term expiring 2032

Managing Director at Gallatin Point Capital since 2019; prior roles at Thomas H. Lee Partners and J.P. Morgan; serves on multiple insurance and financial services boards; BA Yale, MBA Stanford (Arjay Miller Scholar)
